userScope.purpose: Retained for forensic memory acquisition on external systems.
userScope.rideHostTarget: Windows 11 staging/deployment host selected by the user.
userScope.runtimeScope: RIDE stages the utility for transfer and does not imply or perform memory acquisition.

observations.publisherOperatingSystemList: Windows XP, Vista, 7, 8, 10, Server 2003, 2008 and 2012, x86/x64; Windows 11 is not listed.
observations.publisherDistribution: The official product page offers a request form and says a confirmation email follows; there is no direct public artifact URL on the page.
observations.publisherUseDescription: Captures physical memory to raw DMP/RAW/BIN format; the publisher blog describes standalone USB use, configurable output and fragmentation, and scripted silent mode.
observations.terms: The product page says Magnet Free Tools downloads are governed by the End User License Agreement available on the legal page. Exact agreement applicability and product-version terms should be recorded with the acquired artifact.

migrationDisposition.sourceReview: Progressed: official version, declared legacy operating systems, request-form distribution and EULA reference recorded.
migrationDisposition.nextTechnicalStep: Obtain the publisher-supplied 1.20 artifact through the established authorized channel, then record exact hash, signature and embedded notices before candidate admission.
migrationDisposition.licenseReview: Record owner/version NeedsReview when the exact package identity is admitted; this is an administrative marker, not a migration gate.
migrationDisposition.windows11Support: Not accepted. Staging-host choice does not establish tool compatibility, driver behavior or memory-acquisition behavior.
